title: Authentic experience!!
text:
If you are visiting Barcelona, this paella cooking experience is an absolute must. Whether you’re traveling with family, friends, or looking for a unique private or work event, this experience was unforgettable from start to finish.

Marc made my family feel instantly welcome and created such a relaxed, authentic atmosphere. He is incredibly knowledgeable about Barcelona’s history and culture, and he explained everything in a way that was engaging, easy to follow, and calming throughout the experience.

title: Exceptional experience!
text: Exceptional experience. Marc shared stories, informed us of Catalan culture, and was incredibly personable throughout the cooking class. Highly recommend to anyone that visits Barcelona.
author: Carl_J

title: Delicious and fun!!
text: Marc was very kind and knowledgeable!  We all had a wonderful time making paella, learning about the dish and its history. The kitchen space was very cool and the final dish was delicious! Can’t wait to make it back at home!
author: Tamara_P

title: Marc is great!
text: Even though Viator messed up the booking Marc took the time to help us find a place for dinner and handle the refund. If we had the time to reschedule we would. He was so accommodating and communicated with us the entire time. We will make it back and we will book again.
author: Nora_T

title: We had an excellent time...
text: We had an excellent time with Marc learning how to cook paella. Learned a lot about Barcelona and Catalonia. Would highly recommend this fun experience!
author: Ardi_K

title: Amazing experience!
text: Mark was an amazing host and cook.  The experience overall was fantastic in his converted commercial building that presented more like an art gallery, with all the incredible designs created by Mark.  Wonderful evening
author: Bob_M

title: An outstanding and...
text:
An outstanding and informative evening with Marc. He shared his family and personal life experiences with the art of Paella cooking. We participated in preparing the ingredients and cooking.
A delicious dinner followed!
author: Carl_G

title: Perfect Experience with Friends!
text: This experience was perfect!! Loved getting to know Marc and learn more about Catalan culture. Super interesting and very very fun! Lots of laughs & amazing food! Highly highly recommend. We were only in town for two days and made it work!
author: Alexa_R

title: After a time mixup and no...
text: After a time mixup and no chance to reschedule we were able to have this experience with just the two of us and it became the best experience of our entire trip!! Highly recommend you find your way out to this amazing class. We ate amazingly good Paella and had an amazing conversation while learning to cook and so much about Spain in general. Would give it more stars if I could. Thank you so much for an amazing experience.
